design_evaluation.summary: A polished dark-first dashboard-style landing page with a strong hero, clear nav, working theme toggle, login modal, mobile menu, and AI chat panel. Hierarchy and typography are good; main weaknesses are low-contrast secondary text, overlapping floating widgets on smaller screens, and thin accessibility affordances (focus/contrast, modal close target, no visible close control on the chat panel).
strengths: Hero establishes a clear reading order: badge → large two-line headline → subheading → stats → CTAs (ui-home-desktop).
Light/dark themes are both fully rendered and legible, with theme icon switching gear→moon (ui-theme-toggle).
Mobile menu overlay is a clean full-screen nav with tap-friendly spacing and an explicit close button (ui-mobile-menu).
Login modal dims and blurs the background so the form is the sole focal point; labeled inputs and tabbed Login/Register are clear (ui-login-modal).
Chat panel communicates consent state explicitly ('Before we start', disclaimer, checkbox, disabled 'Agree & Start Chat' button) (ui-chat-opens).
Feature cards use consistent structure (icon, title, description, colored action link) across both themes.
